requirement: Personal data may be processed only for a lawful purpose for which the Data Principal has given consent.
evidenceRequired: Tool schema must not extract PII without explicit consent parameter, or must operate on anonymized data.
checkLogic: Scan tool definitions for PII fields (email, phone, aadhaar). If present, verify 'consent' boolean parameter exists in schema.

requirement: Restrictions on transfer of personal data outside India (as notified by Central Government).
evidenceRequired: Documentation of data residency or explicit statement of cross-border data flow.
checkLogic: If dataLocalization == 'cross-border', flag for DPDP Sec 16 review. Require evidence of government notification or anonymization.

regulation: Reserve Bank of India Master Direction on Payment Data
requirement: All data relating to payment systems operated by entities regulated by RBI shall be stored only in India.
evidenceRequired: Infrastructure deployment proof showing India-only regions (e.g., aws:ap-south-1) and no egress to foreign endpoints.
checkLogic: If vendor is financial or tool accesses financial data, dataLocalization MUST be 'india-only'. Any 'cross-border' = non-compliant.

regulation: SEBI Master Circular on Cloud Service Providers
requirement: Critical securities market data must be stored in India. Primary and secondary data centers must be in India.
evidenceRequired: Sovereign cloud certification or MeitY empanelment documentation.
checkLogic: If applicableTo includes 'securities' or 'trading', sovereignCloud MUST be true and dataLocalization MUST be 'india-only'.

requirement: Intermediaries must preserve logs for 180 days and report cyber incidents to CERT-In within 6 hours.
evidenceRequired: Logging architecture diagram showing 180-day retention in Indian jurisdiction.
checkLogic: Verify deployment config includes audit logging enabled and log storage region is 'in-india'.

regulation: MeitY Empanelment of Cloud Service Providers
requirement: Government data must be processed on MeitY-empaneled CSPs with data centers located exclusively in India.
evidenceRequired: CSP name mapped to current MeitY empaneled list (e.g., AWS India, Azure India, Yotta, CtrlS).
checkLogic: If sovereignCloud == true, verify vendor is on MeitY approved list. If false, airGapReady must be evaluated for govt use.

requirement: Zero external network egress. All dependencies and models must be available locally.
evidenceRequired: Network policy manifest showing deny-all egress, and local model/dependency caching proof.
checkLogic: If airGapReady == true, verify no external API calls in code review and no dynamic imports.
